overloads.semanticRole: Returns the default Web server object, i.e. the Web server of the project/database from which the command is called.

params.name: option
params.description: Which Web server object to return

sentinelValues.meaning: Web server database: Web server of the project from which the command is called (default if option is omitted)
Web server host database: Web server of the host database of a component
Web server receiving request: Web server that actually received the request (target Web server)

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the Web server object designated by option (the database's own Web server, a host component's Web server, or the Web server that received the current request).

constraints: The returned 4D.WebServer object exposes the current property values of the designated Web server (e.g. .isRunning); see the WebServer class.
